items.title: Vanderbilt University hit in BYOD ransomware attack, data theft claimed
items.summary: Vanderbilt University warns it is responding to a cyberattack claimed by the BYOD ransomware gang, which claims to have encrypted the university's databases and stolen sensitive student, employee, and research data. [...]
items.title_zh: 范德堡大學遭 BYOD 勒索軟體攻擊，駭客聲稱竊取資料
items.summary_zh: 范德堡大學（Vanderbilt University）警告稱正因應一起網路攻擊，聲稱指控來自 BYOD 勒索軟體犯罪集團，該集團聲稱已加密該大學的資料庫並竊取敏感的學生、員工及研究資料。[...]

items.title: Chrome Update Patches Exploited XML Zero-Day, Eighth This Year
items.summary: The high-severity use-after-free in Chrome’s XML component was reported anonymously on November 6 and is already exploited in attacks. The post Chrome Update Patches Exploited XML Zero-Day, Eighth This Year appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Chrome 更新修補已被利用的 XML 零日漏洞，為今年第 8 個
items.summary_zh: Chrome 的 XML 元件中存在的高風險 Use-After-Free 漏洞於 11 月 6 日被匿名舉報，且已被用於攻擊中。該文章《Chrome Update Patches Exploited XML Zero-Day, Eighth This Year》首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" published
items.summary: N-able has taken its hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down their servers after a security researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, including exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable systems. [...]
items.title_zh: 在 30 多個「零日漏洞」被公開後，N-able 將雲端平台下線
items.summary_zh: 在一名前安控研究人員公開揭露了 30 多個聲稱的零日漏洞（包括可能讓攻擊者控制受害者系統的利用程式）後，N-able 已將其託管的 N-central 環境下線，並呼籲地端客戶關閉其伺服器。[...]

items.title: Hackers exploit SSHole OpenSSH flaw to breach Linux systems
items.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting the "SSHole" vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158) in OpenSSH to execute commands, steal credentials, and establish persistent access. [...]
items.title_zh: 駭客利用 SSHole OpenSSH 漏洞入侵 Linux 系統
items.summary_zh: 駭客正主動利用 OpenSSH 中的「SSHole」漏洞（CVE-2026-123158）來執行命令、竊取憑證並建立持續性存取權限。[...]

items.title: Fireworks AI discloses new breach after cloud provider hack
items.summary: AI infrastructure startup Fireworks has disclosed a new security breach in which attackers accessed its development machines after breaching a third-party cloud provider. [...]
items.title_zh: 雲端服務供應商遭入侵後，Fireworks AI 揭露新資料外洩事件
items.summary_zh: 人工智慧基礎設施新創公司 Fireworks 揭露了一起新的安全外洩事件，攻擊者在入侵第三方雲端服務供應商後，存取了該公司的開發機器。[...]

items.title: SEGA newsletter data breach exposes 2.2 million email addresses
items.summary: Japanese gaming giant SEGA has disclosed that a data breach at its third-party newsletter provider, ARARA, exposed the email addresses of 2.2 million newsletter subscribers. [...]
items.title_zh: SEGA 電子報資料外洩，暴露 220 萬個電子郵件地址
items.summary_zh: 日本遊戲巨擘 SEGA 揭露，其第三方電子報供應商 ARARA 發生資料外洩事件，導致 220 萬名電子報訂閱者的電子郵件地址暴露。[...]

items.title: York University breach exposed personal information dating to 2007
items.summary: York University has announced it suffered a cybersecurity incident in which a threat actor stole personal information people submitted through online forms. [...]
items.title_zh: 約克大學外洩事件暴露可追溯至 2007 年的個人資訊
items.summary_zh: 約克大學宣布遭遇資安事件，威脅者竊取了民眾透過線上表單提交的個人資訊。[...]

items.title: Binance denies data breach after alleged ShinyHunters claims
items.summary: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, has denied claims of a new security breach made by a threat actor using the 'ShinyHunters' handle on a newly emerged underground cybercrime forum. [...]
items.title_zh: 在 ShinyHunters 宣稱入侵後，幣安否認發生資料外洩
items.summary_zh: 全球最大的加密貨幣交易所幣安，否認了威脅者在一個新出現的地下網路犯罪論壇上以「ShinyHunters」帳號所聲稱的新安全外洩事件。[...]

items.title: Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million
items.summary: Online fashion retailer Revolve has told regulators that the September cyberattack affected more than 1.5 million individuals. The post Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Revolve 表明資料外洩受害者人數達 150 萬
items.summary_zh: 線上時尚零售商 Revolve 已向監管機構表示，9 月發生的網路攻擊影響了超過 150 萬名個人。此文章《Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million》首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Iris Plaza Breach May Have Exposed Data of 7.7 Million Customers
items.summary: Hackers compromised an external cloud service used by the shopping platform and may have stolen personal information from it. The post Iris Plaza Breach May Have Exposed Data of 7.7 Million Customers appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Iris Plaza 資料洩漏事件可能暴露 770 萬名客戶資料
items.summary_zh: 駭客入侵了該購物平台使用的外部雲端服務，並可能從中竊取了個人資訊。Iris Plaza 資料洩漏事件可能暴露 770 萬名客戶資料的文章最早出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million
items.summary: Hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information, including Social Security numbers, from the company’s internal systems. The post Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Amplifon Americas 資料洩漏事件影響 130 萬人
items.summary_zh: 駭客從該公司的內部系統竊取了個人、健康和保險資訊，包含社會安全碼。Amplifon Americas 資料洩漏事件影響 130 萬人的文章最早出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Over 3 Million People Hit by Frontline Education Data Breach
items.summary: Frontline Education told Indiana regulators that its August data breach affected over 3 million school district staff and students. The post Over 3 Million People Hit by Frontline Education Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 超過 300 萬人遭受 Frontline Education 資料洩漏事件影響
items.summary_zh: Frontline Education 向印第安納州監管機構表示，其 8 月發生的資料洩漏事件影響了超過 300 萬名學區教職員與學生。超過 300 萬人遭受 Frontline Education 資料洩漏事件影響的文章最早出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
items.summary: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama, the operator of the Iris Plaza shopping platform, disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service the company used. [...]
items.title_zh: 愛麗思歐雅瑪（Iris Ohyama）資料雲端外洩事件揭露 770 萬名客戶資訊
items.summary_zh: 營運 Iris Plaza 購物平台的日本製造商愛麗思歐雅瑪（Iris Ohyama）披露，在該公司使用的第三方雲端服務遭到未經授權的存取後，大約 770 萬人的個人資訊可能已遭外洩。[...]

items.title: Hackers Exploiting ‘SSHole’ Authentication Bypass in OpenSSH
items.summary: The initial exploitation attempts are attributed to botnets and crypto miners, but other threat actors are expected to follow suit. The post Hackers Exploiting ‘SSHole’ Authentication Bypass in OpenSSH appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 駭客正在利用 OpenSSH 中的「SSHole」驗證繞過漏洞
items.summary_zh: 最初的漏洞利用嘗試被歸因於殭屍網路與加密貨幣挖礦程式，但預計其他威脅波及者很快也會跟進。駭客正在利用 OpenSSH 中的「SSHole」驗證繞過漏洞的文章最早出現在 SecurityWeek。
